source:
`include "disciplines.vams"
module m(u0,u1,y0,y1); input u0,u1; output y0,y1; electrical u0,u1,y0,y1; analog begin V(y0)<+2*V(u0); V(y1)<+2*V(u1); end endmodule
spectre_deck:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Vomit (u0 0) vsource type=pulse val0=-.25 val1=.75 rise=.125 fall=.125 width=.25 period=1
Vzero (u1 0) vsource type=pulse val0=-.25 val1=.75 rise=.125 fall=.125 width=.25 period=1 delay=0
DUT (u0 u1 y0 y1) m
opts options reltol=1e-7 vabstol=1e-9 iabstol=1e-12 precision="%24.17g"
tran tran stop=2 maxstep=0.25 strobetimes=[0 .03125 .125 .25 .375 .5 .625] strobeoutput=all
save u0 u1 y0 y1
